title: 5.10 Ordering Politely 2: At the Market and Shops
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals, ask prices and order politely at a café or market.
lesson_title: Ordering Politely 2: At the Market and Shops
sub_lesson_title: Ordering Politely 2: At the Market and Shops
goal: Shop politely: Kann ich bitte drei Äpfel haben? Möchten Sie eine Tüte? Ja, bitte. / Nein, danke.
grammar_function: Möchten Sie + thing? Ja, bitte. / Nein, danke.

cards.pedagogy_note: Separate second customer: older woman with silver hair, plum blouse, two oranges and her own cream tote declines a paper bag. The first customer accepted; this is not a reversal of her answer.
